stories.title: The Canopy Watchers and the Amber Root
stories.question: Can two wary forest dwellers trust each other to harvest the bioluminescent amber root before the midnight frost locks the deep ravine?
stories.answer: Through shared strength and careful coordination, they anchor the vine bridge and unearth the root, securing warmth for both their families through the harsh winter.

story_beats.headline: The Frayed Crossing
story_beats.speech: The frost is coming fast, Mira. We must cross the chasm now or lose the amber root forever.
story_beats.label: Beat One
story_beats.visual_prompt: Wide shot of the deep whispering_ravine. Toren stands on the near slate ledge wearing his heavy tan wool coat, holding the frayed hemp climbing_harness in his leather-gloved hands. Across the gap, Mira peers down anxiously from the opposite side, her woven cap dusted with early frost flakes.

story_beats.headline: Securing the Anchor
story_beats.speech: Hold the anchor steady while I wedge this timber brace into the crevice so the bridge doesn't snap.
story_beats.label: Beat Two
story_beats.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Toren kneeling on the damp rock face, firmly pressing a carved wooden wedge into a slate fissure. Mira leans in from the left, gripping the climbing_harness tightly to tension the line, her olive-green tunic stained with damp moss.

story_beats.headline: Reaching the Tuber
story_beats.speech: Careful now, the soil is giving way beneath the roots. Reach down together on my three.
story_beats.label: Beat Three
story_beats.visual_prompt: Close-up of Mira and Toren kneeling side by side at the edge of the chasm floor. Both reach into the dark loam with gloved hands, their fingers brushing against the glowing amber_root that pulses with warm golden light.

story_beats.headline: The Warm Hearth
story_beats.speech: We made it across in time. This radiant root will keep both our forest homes warm until spring arrives.
story_beats.label: Beat Four
story_beats.visual_prompt: Warm interior shot of a rustic wooden shelter at dusk. Mira and Toren sit together by a glowing hearth, smiling as they place the glowing amber_root into a stone basin, casting long, cozy amber shadows across the timber walls.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic stop-motion animation aesthetic with rich mossy textures, deep emerald shadows, and warm golden bioluminescent lighting.

characters.mira: A nimble wood-forager with bright amber eyes, braided dark hair tucked beneath a woven cap, wearing a patched olive-green tunic, leather travel trousers, and thick-soled climbing boots.
characters.toren: A broad-shouldered, patient stone-carver with a kind weathered face, a neatly trimmed grey-streaked beard, wearing a heavy tan wool coat, sturdy leather gloves, and a tool belt laden with wooden wedges.

locations.whispering_ravine: A plunging, mist-filled chasm deep within the ancient timberlands, spanned by a fraying suspension rope and walled with damp slate and creeping moss.

objects.amber_root: A thick, knobby subterranean tuber that pulses with a warm golden luminescence, cradled in a bed of damp black soil.
objects.climbing_harness: A woven hemp rope harness with polished wooden carabiners, smelling faintly of pine resin.
objects.meteorological_dial: A circular brass and cedarwood pocket dial with etched frost markings and a spinning copper needle pointing toward a falling gradient.
